time_zero_method: First sample where the mean absolute amplitude of the (dewowed) stack is ≥ 0.05 × the stack peak. Not a picked ground wave.
sec_formula: gain(t) = max(t, dt)^n * exp(α t)  (Jol 2009 SEC; default n=2, α=0)

bandpass.adjustment_reason: Antenna default 0.2–2.0 × AntennaMHz (80–800 MHz) is not Nyquist-safe (Nyquist 250 MHz). Applied documented safe high-cut 0.8 × Nyquist = 200 MHz. This is not a silent clamp to 0.999 Nyquist.
bandpass.formula: Butterworth SOS band-pass, order 4 unless overridden; filtfilt

formula: optional dewow + optional time-zero + optional SEC + optional Nyquist-safe Butterworth (Jol 2009)
limitations: Dewow, time-zero, SEC gain, and band-pass are processing choices. A visually enhanced radargram does not have improved geological certainty.
Utilities, voids, archaeology, water table, and rebar are not established.
